# GoodMem .NET SDK Reference

Generated from the published `PairSystems.Goodmem.Client` 2.0.0 NuGet package — every
signature, parameter, and description below comes from the package's XML
documentation and reflected assembly metadata. Targets `net8.0` and `net10.0`
(runs on .NET 8, 9, and 10) and depends only on the base class library.

## Install

```bash
dotnet add package PairSystems.Goodmem.Client
```

## Client construction and auth

`GoodmemClient` (namespace `Goodmem.Client`) exposes every operation as
`client.<Namespace>.<Method>Async(...)`. The surface is **async-only**: every
method returns a `Task<T>` (or an `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` for pagination and
streaming) and takes a trailing `CancellationToken ct = default`, which is
omitted from the parameter lists below. Request/response models live in
`Goodmem.Client.Models`; per-call options types live in `Goodmem.Client.Api`.

The SDK does not read environment variables itself — read them in your code
and pass them in. The conventional variables are `GOODMEM_BASE_URL` and
`GOODMEM_API_KEY`. Never hardcode keys.

```csharp
using System;
using Goodmem.Client;

var baseUrl = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GOODMEM_BASE_URL")
    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("GOODMEM_BASE_URL is not set");

using var client = new GoodmemClient(new GoodmemClientOptions
{
    BaseUrl = baseUrl,
    ApiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GOODMEM_API_KEY"),
});
```

Constructors (reflected):

```csharp
GoodmemClient(GoodmemClientOptions options)
GoodmemClient(string baseUrl, string? apiKey = null, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
```

`GoodmemClientOptions` properties:

- `BaseUrl` (`string`, required): Base URL of the GoodMem server (e.g. `https://api.goodmem.ai`). Required. May include a mount-path prefix, which is preserved on every request.
- `ApiKey` (`string?`): API key. May be null — the bootstrap endpoints (`/v1/system/info`, `/v1/system/init`) are callable without a key; every other endpoint returns 401 from the server, so the server (not the SDK) owns the "missing key" error.
- `Timeout` (`TimeSpan?`): Request timeout for the SDK-managed HttpClient. Conflicts with `GoodmemClientOptions.HttpClient` (a supplied client already owns its timeout) — setting both throws.
- `HttpClient` (`HttpClient?`): Bring-your-own HttpClient. When set, the SDK does not build or dispose an HttpClient. Mutually exclusive with `GoodmemClientOptions.Timeout`.
- `MaxStreamLineBytes` (`int`): Maximum size, in bytes, of a single NDJSON stream event (`memories.retrieve`, `ping.stream`). A single event is buffered in memory, so this bounds worst-case allocation; a line over the cap ends iteration with a diagnostic naming the limit. Zero or negative selects the 8 MiB default. Raise it (or leave `RetrieveOptions.FetchMemoryContent` unset and fetch bodies via `Memories.ContentAsync`) if a large inlined document trips the cap. Applies in both SDK-managed and bring-your-own-HttpClient modes.

`GoodmemClient` implements `IDisposable` — prefer `using`. Disposes the SDK-managed HttpClient. A bring-your-own HttpClient is left untouched.

## Streaming and pagination

- Paginated list endpoints (`Admin.RetrieveMemoryLogPoliciesListAsync`, `Memories.ListAsync`, `Memories.PagesAsync`, `Spaces.ListAsync`) return
  `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`: `await foreach` walks every item lazily and the SDK
  fetches subsequent pages on demand; `break` stops early without fetching
  more. The other list endpoints (`ApiKeys.ListAsync`, `Embedders.ListAsync`, `Llms.ListAsync`, `Rerankers.ListAsync`) are not paginated
  and return a single response object wrapping the full list.
- Streaming endpoints (`Memories.RetrieveAsync`, `Memories.RetrieveRawAsync`, `Ping.StreamAsync`) yield NDJSON events as an
  `IAsyncEnumerable`. A single event is buffered in memory;
  `GoodmemClientOptions.MaxStreamLineBytes` bounds the worst-case allocation
  (8 MiB default).

```csharp
using Goodmem.Client.Api;

// Pagination: lazily walks every page.
await foreach (var space in client.Spaces.ListAsync())
    Console.WriteLine(space.SpaceId);

// Streaming retrieval (RAG): typed NDJSON events.
var spaceId = "your-space-uuid";
await foreach (var ev in client.Memories.RetrieveAsync(
    "What do you know about GoodMem?",
    new RetrieveOptions { SpaceIds = new[] { spaceId } }))
{
    if (ev.AbstractReply is { } reply)
        Console.WriteLine(reply.Text);
}
```

## Errors

All exception types live in the `Goodmem.Client` namespace alongside the client:

- `GoodmemException` (extends Exception) — Base of every error the SDK raises for an operation — HTTP status errors (`ApiException` and its typed kin) and transport failures (`NetworkException`). Catch this to handle any SDK-originated failure. Plain caller-fault validation (empty id, null request, mutex/range violations) is thrown as `ArgumentException`, NOT a `GoodmemException`, so it never collapses into the SDK-error bucket (inv-exception-types-mapping).
- `NetworkException` (extends GoodmemException) — A transport-level failure (DNS, connect, timeout, mid-read drop). The underlying cause is on `Exception.InnerException`. inv-network-error-wrap.
- `ApiException` (extends GoodmemException) — Base for any HTTP 4xx/5xx returned by the server. The message embeds the server's response body (truncated) so a log shows why the call failed (inv-http-error-body); the full payload is on `ApiException.Body`. A status without a typed subclass surfaces as a plain `ApiException`. Adds `StatusCode` (`int`), `Body` (`string`).
- `BadRequestException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 400 Bad Request.
- `AuthenticationException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 401 Unauthorized — the API key is missing or invalid.
- `PermissionDeniedException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 403 Forbidden — the caller lacks permission for the resource.
- `NotFoundException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 404 Not Found.
- `ConflictException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 409 Conflict.
- `UnprocessableEntityException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.
- `RateLimitException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. `RateLimitException.RetryAfterSeconds` holds the parsed `Retry-After` header — seconds to wait, whether the server sent delta-seconds or an HTTP-date — or null when the header is absent or unparseable. Adds `RetryAfterSeconds` (`long?`).
- `InternalServerException` (extends ApiException) — HTTP 5xx server-side fault.

  - `Statuses` (`IReadOnlyList<PurgeableBackgroundJobStatus>?`): Optional terminal background job statuses to target for purging. If omitted, all terminal statuses are eligible. #### `Memories.CreateFromStreamAsync(string spaceId, Stream content, string fileName, JsonMemoryCreationRequest? request = null, CancellationToken ct = default) -> Task<Memory>`

Create a memory by streaming an arbitrary `Stream` as the multipart file part — the .NET analog of Go's `CreateFromReader`, so a large upload is never fully buffered in memory. The stream is read to completion but NOT disposed (the caller owns it). Content type is inferred from `fileName` when `request` doesn't set one; the file part carries the content, so any `OriginalContent`/ `OriginalContentB64` on the request is ignored and the caller's request is never mutated.

Parameters:
- `spaceId` (`string`)
- `content` (`Stream`)
- `fileName` (`string`)
- `request` (`JsonMemoryCreationRequest?`, optional): Request body for creating a new Memory. A Memory represents content stored in a space.

  - `OriginalContent` (`string?`): Original content as plain text (use either this or originalContentB64)
  - `OriginalContentB64` (`string?`): Original content as base64-encoded binary data (use either this or originalContent)
  - `OriginalContentRef` (`string?`): Reference to external content location
  - `ContentType` (`string?`): MIME type of the content
  - `Metadata` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?`): Additional metadata for the memory
  - `ChunkingConfig` (`ChunkingConfiguration?`): Chunking strategy for this memory (if not provided, uses space default)
  - `ExtractPageImages` (`bool?`): Optional hint to extract page images for eligible document types (for example, PDFs)
  - `FileField` (`string?`): Optional multipart file field name to bind binary content; required when multiple files are uploaded in a batch multipart request.

#### `Memories.RetrieveAsync(string message, RetrieveOptions? options = null, CancellationToken ct = default) -> IAsyncEnumerable<RetrieveMemoryEvent>`

Runs a retrieval from the flat convenience parameters: SpaceIds expand into SpaceKeys and the flat post-processor keys assemble into a ChatPostProcessor.

Parameters:
- `message` (`string`)
- `options` (`RetrieveOptions?`, optional): Flat convenience parameters for `Memories.RetrieveAsync`. `SpaceIds` is expanded into `SpaceKeys` and the flat ChatPostProcessor keys are assembled into a `PostProcessor`; every property is optional. For full control over the request body use `Memories.RetrieveRawAsync`.
  - `SpaceIds` (`IReadOnlyList<string>?`): Space UUIDs to search; each is expanded into a SpaceKey.
  - `FetchMemory` (`bool?`): Whether memory-definition records are streamed (server default true).
  - `FetchMemoryContent` (`bool?`): Whether streamed memory records include original content bytes.
  - `RequestedSize` (`int?`): Maximum number of memories to retrieve.
  - `LlmId` (`string?`): The ID of the LLM to process the retrieved memories, e.g., RAG. Assembles the nested `PostProcessor` structure automatically. If unset, no LLM will be used. Setting `llm_id` or `reranker_id` activates post-processing; the remaining post-processor params below (`llm_temp`, `gen_token_budget`, etc.) only take effect when at least one is set. Activates LLM post-processing and unlocks the llmTemp / genTokenBudget / prompt / sysPrompt keys.
  - `RerankerId` (`string?`): The ID of the reranker to process the retrieved memories. If unset, no reranker will be used. Activates reranking and unlocks relevanceThreshold.
  - `LlmTemp` (`double?`): LLM temperature for post-processing. Valid range is 0.0-2.0. Defaults to 0.3 on the server. Only applies when `llm_id` is set. Requires llm_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `GenTokenBudget` (`int?`): Token budget for LLM post-processing. Must be positive. If the token budget is insufficient, the server will return an error. Defaults to 512 on the server. Only applies when `llm_id` is set. Requires llm_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `RelevanceThreshold` (`double?`): Minimum relevance score for retrieved memories. Only applies when `reranker_id` is set. Requires reranker_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `MaxResults` (`int?`): Maximum number of retrieved memories to return. Must be positive. Defaults to 10 on the server. Only applies when `llm_id` or `reranker_id` is set. Requires at least one of llm_id or reranker_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `Prompt` (`string?`): Custom prompt for LLM post-processing. If unset, the server's default prompt is used. Only applies when `llm_id` is set. Requires llm_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `SysPrompt` (`string?`): System prompt for LLM post-processing. If unset, the server's default system prompt is used. Only applies when `llm_id` is set. Requires llm_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.
  - `ChronologicalResort` (`bool?`): Re-sort retrieved memories chronologically after semantic ranking. Defaults to true on the server. Only applies when `llm_id` or `reranker_id` is set. Requires at least one of llm_id or reranker_id to be set — RetrieveAsync rejects it otherwise.

Returns: `IAsyncEnumerable<RetrieveMemoryEvent>`

#### `Memories.RetrieveRawAsync(RetrieveMemoryRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default) -> IAsyncEnumerable<RetrieveMemoryEvent>`

Advanced semantic memory retrieval with JSON.

Parameters:
- `request` (`RetrieveMemoryRequest`): Request body for semantic memory retrieval with optional embedder weight overrides.
  - `Message` (`string`, required): Primary query/message for semantic search.
  - `Context` (`IReadOnlyList<ContextItem>?`): Optional context items (text or binary) to provide additional context for the search.
  - `SpaceKeys` (`IReadOnlyList<SpaceKey>?`): List of spaces to search with optional per-embedder weight overrides.
  - `RequestedSize` (`int?`): Maximum number of memories to retrieve.
  - `OutputBudget` (`TokenBudget?`): Optional soft cap for generated retrieve replies. When set to a positive token count, chat post-processing uses this value as the LLM completion-token budget.
  - `FetchMemory` (`bool?`): Whether to include streamed memory-definition records in the response. Defaults to true when omitted. These records include memory metadata and audit fields, but omit originalContent unless fetchMemoryContent is true.
  - `FetchMemoryContent` (`bool?`): Whether streamed memory-definition records include originalContent bytes. Requires fetchMemory=true. Defaults to false when omitted.
  - `Hnsw` (`HnswOptions?`): Optional request-level HNSW tuning overrides. Advanced usage; available on POST retrieve.
  - `PostProcessor` (`PostProcessor?`): Optional post-processor configuration to transform retrieval results.
  - `Logging` (`LoggingOptions?`): Optional durable request logging block for POST retrieve requests. Set logging.enabled=true to opt in, or supply flat scalar logging.callerAttributes to attach if caller opt-in or an admin policy logs the request.

Returns: `IAsyncEnumerable<RetrieveMemoryEvent>`

  - `TargetId` (`string`, required): Target resource ID (UUID)
  - `TargetTypeHint` (`PingTargetType?`): Optional hint for the target resource type. One of `Unknown`, `TargetTypeUnspecified`, `Embedder`, `Reranker`, `Llm`.
  - `Count` (`int?`): Number of probes to run (0 uses server default)
  - `IntervalMs` (`int?`): Delay between probes in milliseconds (0 uses server default)

  - `Payload` (`string?`): Explicit UTF-8 payload to send with each probe (mutually exclusive with payloadSizeBytes)
  - `PayloadSizeBytes` (`int?`): Synthetic payload size in bytes (mutually exclusive with payload)
  - `MaxInFlight` (`int?`): Maximum concurrent probes (defaults to 1)
  - `Jitter` (`bool?`): Add jitter to probe scheduling

#### `Rerankers.CreateAsync(RerankerCreationRequest request, string? apiKey = null, CancellationToken ct = default) -> Task<RerankerResponse>`

Create a new reranker.

Parameters:
- `request` (`RerankerCreationRequest`): Request body for creating a new Reranker. A Reranker represents a configuration for reranking search results.
  - `DisplayName` (`string`, required): User-facing name of the reranker
  - `Description` (`string?`): Description of the reranker
  - `ProviderType` (`ProviderType?`): Type of reranking provider. One of `Unknown`, `Openai`, `Vllm`, `Tei`, `LlamaCpp`, `Voyage`, `Cohere`, `Jina`.
  - `EndpointUrl` (`string?`): API endpoint URL
  - `ApiPath` (`string?`): API path for reranking request (defaults: Cohere /v2/rerank, Jina /v1/rerank, others /rerank)
  - `ModelIdentifier` (`string`, required): Model identifier
  - `SupportedModalities` (`IReadOnlyList<Modality>?`): Supported content modalities (defaults to TEXT if not provided). One of `Unknown`, `Text`, `Image`, `Audio`, `Video`.
  - `Credentials` (`EndpointAuthentication?`): Structured credential payload describing how to authenticate with the provider. Required for SaaS providers; optional for local or proxy providers.
  - `Labels` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>?`): User-defined labels for categorization
  - `Version` (`string?`): Version information
  - `MonitoringEndpoint` (`string?`): Monitoring endpoint URL
  - `OwnerId` (`string?`): Optional owner ID. If not provided, derived from the authentication context. Requires CREATE_RERANKER_ANY permission if specified.
  - `RerankerId` (`string?`): Optional client-provided UUID for idempotent creation. If not provided, server generates a new UUID. Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if ID is already in use.
- `apiKey` (`string?`, optional)

Only fields that should be updated need to be included. supportedModalities replaces the stored set only when the array contains at least one value; empty or omitted leaves it unchanged and does not count as an update by itself.

  - `Credentials` (`EndpointAuthentication?`): Structured credential payload describing how to authenticate with the provider. Omit to keep existing credentials.
  - `ReplaceLabels` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>?`): Replace all existing labels with these (mutually exclusive with mergeLabels)

### client.Spaces

#### `Spaces.CreateAsync(SpaceCreationRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default) -> Task<Space>`

Create a new Space.

Parameters:
- `request` (`SpaceCreationRequest`): Request body for creating a new Space. A Space is a container for organizing related memories with vector embeddings.
  - `Name` (`string`, required): The desired name for the space. Must be unique within the user's scope.
  - `Labels` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>?`): A set of key-value pairs to categorize or tag the space. Used for filtering and organizational purposes.
  - `SpaceEmbedders` (`IReadOnlyList<SpaceEmbedderConfig>`, required): List of embedder configurations to associate with this space. At least one embedder configuration is required. Each specifies an embedder ID and a relative default retrieval weight used when no per-request overrides are provided.
  - `PublicRead` (`bool?`): Indicates if the space and its memories can be read by unauthenticated users or users other than the owner. Defaults to false.
  - `OwnerId` (`string?`): Optional owner ID. If not provided, derived from the authentication context. Requires CREATE_SPACE_ANY permission if specified.
  - `DefaultChunkingConfig` (`ChunkingConfiguration?`): Default chunking strategy for memories in this space
  - `SpaceId` (`string?`): Optional client-provided UUID for idempotent creation. If not provided, server generates a new UUID. Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if ID is already in use.
